info.title: wasm-transit server
info.description: The Go server's HTTP surface. Reads are public. When sign-in is on (-oidc flags), writes need a bearer token and a policy rule. When it is off, every request passes.

get.summary: Relay an agency feed that the browser cannot fetch directly.
get.description: The route exists only with -rt-proxy. The server fetches the URL and relays the upstream status, body, and Content-Type, with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The http(s) URL to fetch.

200.description: The upstream answer. Other upstream statuses relay as they are.

400.description: The url parameter is missing, or it is not http(s).

502.description: The upstream fetch failed, or its answer is larger than 32 MB.

404.description: The relay is off. Without -rt-proxy the path is a static file, and there is none.

get.summary: Answer liveness.
get.description: The handler reads nothing and accepts any method.

get.summary: Answer whether this process should get traffic.
get.description: The handler accepts any method.

200.description: Status ready, or degraded while the bucket does not answer but cached heads serve.

503.description: Status unavailable or draining.

get.summary: Get the manifest that pins the published set.
get.description: In store mode the manifest is the manifest pointer's head blob, and its ETag is that hash. Without a store the ETag is a key of what the manifest pins. A read the bucket did not confirm carries X-Store-Stale and X-Store-As-Of. The handler accepts any method.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

500.description: The server failed to read the store or to run a module.

503.description: The store does not answer. Nothing was written. The response carries Retry-After.

get.summary: Get the import answer of the configured feed.
get.description: The ETag is the network hash. The body is gzipped (Content-Encoding) when Accept-Encoding names gzip. The handler accepts any method.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

404.description: No feed is configured (-feed).

500.description: The feed did not import.

get.summary: Get the bare network document, gzipped.
get.description: The body is gzip bytes as Content-Type application/gzip, never Content-Encoding. The ETag is the network hash. The handler accepts any method.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

404.description: No feed is configured (-feed).

500.description: The feed did not import.

get.summary: Get the import's boundary.
get.description: The ETag is the network hash. The handler accepts any method.

schema.description: The feed's numbering that the live feeds name.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

404.description: No feed is configured (-feed).

500.description: The feed did not import.

get.summary: Get the canonical streets document.
get.description: The ETag is the streets hash. The body is gzipped (Content-Encoding) when Accept-Encoding names gzip. The handler accepts any method.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

404.description: No street layer is configured (-streets).

500.description: The streets did not import.

get.summary: Get the walk table over the published streets and network.
get.description: The ETag is the walk table hash. The body is gzipped (Content-Encoding) when Accept-Encoding names gzip. The handler accepts any method.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

404.description: No feed or no street layer is configured.

500.description: The walk table did not derive.

get.summary: Get the server's edit document.
get.description: In store mode it is the edits pointer's head blob, with the hash as ETag, and a 304 on If-None-Match. Without a store it is the dev store's document. A read the bucket did not confirm carries X-Store-Stale and X-Store-As-Of.

304.description: The If-None-Match header names the current ETag.

500.description: The server failed to read the store or to run a module.

503.description: The store does not answer. Nothing was written. The response carries Retry-After.

post.summary: Merge the client's edit document into the server's.
post.description: cap-sync merges and submits the records. The answer is the converged document, and the client adopts it whole. In store mode the server retries the commit while the pointer moves. When sign-in is on, it needs write on the edits pointer. A field the written document carries that this build does not know is kept, never refused (D-167). The response's X-Unknown-Fields header names each such field, and the server logs the write.

schema.description: An edit document. An older version (a bare array, v1) comes forward through cap-migrate.

200.description: The converged document. In store mode the ETag is its hash.

400.description: The body does not read, or the sync module refuses it.

401.description: Sign-in is on, and the request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: Sign-in is on, and the policy (cap-authz) denies the action on the pointer.

409.description: Store mode: the edits pointer moved on every retry.

500.description: The dev store failed to persist the document.

503.description: The store does not answer. Nothing was written. The response carries Retry-After.

get.summary: Get a pointer's head.
get.description: Store mode only. A read the bucket did not confirm carries X-Store-Stale and X-Store-As-Of.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The pointer name.

400.description: The path names no pointer, or it has extra segments.

404.description: No store is configured, or no such pointer.

500.description: The server failed to read the store or to run a module.

503.description: The store does not answer. Nothing was written. The response carries Retry-After.

post.summary: Commit a document to a pointer (compare and swap).
post.description: Store mode only. For kind edit_records the server merges `client` through cap-sync in one attempt. Every other write is governed by the kind table (-kinds, D-202): a kind it does not name is refused, a kind with its own route is refused naming the route (plans, network_document, plan.*, stops, stop_requests, build, the derived documents, and the rest), and a kind written by pointer (the policy) heads only its pointers and is checked by its module's validate op. The server stores the module's canonical bytes, produced by it. document_hash, when present, is asserted against the bytes sent. When sign-in is on, it needs write on the pointer. For edit_records, a field the client's records carry that this build does not know is kept, never refused (D-167). The response's X-Unknown-Fields header names each such field.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The pointer name.

200.description: The new head. The ETag is its hash.

400.description: A bad path or body, a missing kind on create, a missing client or document, a refused kind or pointer, or a refused merge.

401.description: Sign-in is on, and the request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: Sign-in is on, and the policy (cap-authz) denies the action on the pointer.

404.description: The server runs without a store (-store).

409.description: The pointer moved since `from`.

422.description: The kind's module refuses the document: its answer, with what makes it wrong (`issues`).

500.description: The server failed to read the store or to run a module.

503.description: The store does not answer. Nothing was written. The response carries Retry-After.

An entry that is not JSON is answered as its text in `unreadable`. When sign-in is on, it needs the audit rule on the edits pointer, because each entry names its writer.

post.summary: Revert one entry of the disruptions log, as a new entry.
post.description: Store mode only. cap-log answers the entry, with each record cap-sync writes back: its state before entry `seq`, stamped to win the merge; a record the entry created is retired (D-193). When sign-in is on, it needs the audit rule on the edits pointer.

post.description: Store mode only. A missing entry below the head stops writes to the log. This writes an entry with no changes at the missing seq, with the cause as its note. When sign-in is on, it needs the audit rule on the edits pointer.

A write sent again with its key lands once. The alerts and notes logs take the same intent write (D-189). When sign-in is on, each op needs the write rule on its document's pointer (stops, stop_requests).

post.summary: Publish a plan's network as a pick.
post.description: Store mode only. The body is a network document in any serialization, gzipped or not. cap-network validates it, a stops document is read over it, and cap-plans freezes the network and adopts it (D-191). The server commits the network to plan.<id>, then writes the freeze and the adoption as one entry of the plans log. ?purpose= says what the frozen version is (default "published"). When sign-in is on, it needs write on the plans pointer. A field the written document carries that this build does not know is kept, never refused (D-167). The response's X-Unknown-Fields header names each such field, and the server logs the write.

post.summary: Write one note, new or edited.
post.description: Store mode only. The body is one note, not a whole document. cap-notes writes it over the notes document in force (write), stamped with the verified writer and the server's clock, so a page never names who wrote a note. The server records the next document as one entry of the notes log. The same text written again changes nothing. When sign-in is on, it needs write on the notes pointer. No GTFS-rt feed carries a note (D-214).

id.description: The note's id. A new id is a new note; a held id edits that note's text.

target.description: What the note is about: {kind: trip, trip, date, start_secs}, {kind: edit, id}, {kind: alert, id}, or {kind: stop, stop}. A held note's target never changes.

text.description: The note's text. It is not blank.

200.description: The notes document in force, and the note's id.

400.description: The body is not {id, target, text}, or the module fails.

404.description: The server runs without a store (-store).

422.description: cap-notes refuses the write: a blank text, a target that names no id, or another target for a held note.

500.description: The server failed to read the store or to run a module.

Nothing is put in force. When sign-in is on, it needs write on the plans pointer.

An entry that is not JSON is answered as its text in `unreadable`. When sign-in is on, it needs the audit rule on the plans pointer, because each entry names its writer.

Envelope.description: A blob's envelope: its kind, its version, and the producer.

produced_by.description: cap-<id>@sha256:<hex>, or server for host-owned documents.

at_ms.description: The head record's commit time, Unix ms.

as_of_ms.description: When the bucket last confirmed the head, Unix ms.

stale.description: Present and true while the bucket does not answer.

LogEntry.description: One commit record of a pointer's log.

from.description: The prior head. Empty on create.

writer.description: The writer. Empty unless the caller holds an audit rule (or sign-in is off).

entries.description: The records after the latest record whose `to` is `since` (all records when `since` is empty). Null when `since` is not in the log or the pointer does not exist.

current.description: The head hash. Empty when the pointer does not exist.

whole.description: True when `since` is outside the log: the client takes the whole current document.

from.description: The head the writer read. Empty on create.

kind.description: The document kind. Required when the pointer does not exist. Ignored otherwise.

client.description: For kind edit_records: the client's edit document. Required for that kind. A client on an older build sends version 1, a bare array of records.

document.description: For other kinds: the raw document text, stored verbatim. Required for those kinds.

document_hash.description: Optional. The store asserts it against the sha256 of the bytes.

PointerCommit.description: The new head after a commit.

warnings.description: What the kind's module accepts and names for a person (a policy nobody can change again). Absent when there is none.

Conflict.description: The pointer moved since the writer read it. Re-read and retry.

Refusals.description: The module's refusals. The write is not stored.

warnings.description: The network's warnings, then each visited stop not in service over the pick's period.

NotConfigured.description: The server has no backend for this service.

WorkOrder.description: The work order system's answer, in the request's terms.

landed.description: The key landed before: the work order system was not asked again.

Permissions.description: The policy projected onto the caller.

store_as_of_ms.description: When the bucket last confirmed the head. Present while store is stale.

NetworkImport.description: cap-network's import answer for the configured feed, served as it is.

boundary.description: The feed's numbering that the live feeds name.

Service.description: Where a page asks an external service on this origin.

query.description: The query policy the path applies, by op (parameter to value).

Manifest.description: The pins of the published set.

network_hash.description: Empty when no feed is configured.

feed_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the GTFS zip. Empty when no feed is configured.

wasm_hash.description: The hash of the sync module this server runs.

edit_records_hash.description: The edit document (the disruptions log's fold), store mode (D-190).

frozen_versions_hash.description: The frozen versions (the plans log's fold), store mode (D-191).

notes_hash.description: The notes document (the notes log's fold), store mode (D-214).

generated_at.description: Unix seconds when this manifest was built.

services.description: The external services this deployment offers. A service it does not list is off.
